node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_rb dynamic pkp\en57_v2 EN57-1000rb EN57RB_GSO_WKM1_KM_NS 0 nobody 0 0 enddynamic
crew: event autotest_crew_off putvalues 0 none 0 0 0 Crew:{{vehicle}} 0 0 endevent
